thread:
maria: quick heads-up — saw ~8-12% failed handshakes from APAC -> origin this morning, started ~03:12 PST. TLS alerts show \"illegal_parameter\" during ClientHello processing. sample: `ClientHello{extensions:[sni: \"\", alpn: \"h2\", ...]}`

devon: do we have any recent RBAC/KMS changes? e.g. proxy key access or cert rotation?

maria: checked audit logs and cert rotation window — nothing in last 72h. KMS decrypts for server certs successful (`Decrypt` logs show latency normal). No rolling deploys recorded.

sre-jen: can you paste the proxy config? any change to `tls_min_version` or `sni_policy`? also which proxy (edge-proxy-v2)?

maria: edge-proxy-v2. config snippet:
```
 tls:
   min_version: TLS1_2
   sni_strict: true
   accept_empty_sni: false
```

aj: @maria interesting — we flipped `sni_strict` to true in the apac rollout last week for routing harden. might be related; empty/blank SNI clients will be dropped.

devon: any known clients that send empty SNI? older mobile SDKs / some java clients can, or probes from load balancer health checks.

maria: samples show variety: some internal health-checks (10.32.*), some external from a mobile ISP. We flagged one where CH extensions had an extra unknown extension id=65281 — looks like a custom extension aggregator.

sre-jen: plan: 1) temporarily set `accept_empty_sni: true` in apac to see if rate drops 2) enable verbose TLS debug for 24h and capture ClientHello samples 3) add a 1% sampling to dump full TLS handshake metadata to s3 for forensics

aj: +1. Also add a gated rollback for the sni_strict flip to the runbook. I'll own the rollback.

sec-bot: ALERT: Created incident INC-2026-0035 for \"clienthello-extension-anomalies-apac\" and added oncall rotation.

oncall: assigned to devon. pinged infra for config change window.

devon: making the config patch now, will patch canary edge in apac 03:45 and monitor.

maria: after canary, I saw handshake failures drop to 0.9% on canary, holding. collecting more samples.

devon: rolling to 10% then 100% if stable. pushing audit note: `sni_strict=true -> rollback`.

sre-jen: followups: we should add a telemetry flag for unknown ClientHello extensions (count by extension id + client ip ASN) and add an alert if >0.5% of traffic in region.

maria: filing a GH issue for telemetry and adding example log schema. also we should check vendor SDKs for updates.

aj: also a postmortem template please, mark as P1? impact low but risk high.

maria: agreed, will draft postmortem. closing thread when PM posted. :white_check_mark:
